<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that customers setting up teams cannot preview upcoming interface changes before they go live. I checked the five most similar items: the completed 'Workspace administration' story (4131) covers permissions and team configuration but says nothing about previewing upcoming interface changes; the unstarted stories 4133 and 4137 address classifier thresholds and reporting navigation; the Notion page covers policyholder milestone notifications; and the completed bulk upload story (4127) is unrelated. No shipped story or roadmap item addresses advance visibility of interface changes, so the problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
